decisions.reason: As a dedicated schlager release close to the core catalog, it carries enough sunk editorial and stocking effort and visible commitment that management would likely keep it unless results were clearly poor.

Because this illustrated series spans several models and was prominently presented, it represents the strongest investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes continued support likely.
A jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's reissue identity and genre-broadening strategy, so management can justify staying with it and attribute any weak sales to temporary niche-demand factors.
A multi-disc box set is a higher-effort, reputation-bearing product near the firm's established offer, which makes management inclined to persist rather than reverse course quickly.
This compilation CD appears to have had the weakest public commitment and least distinctive positioning, making it the easiest product to discontinue and reallocate resources away from.
